description.value:
Prerequisite: Must have Excavation

You have learned to increase the density of your stone creations. The amount of hit points each cube created by your Excavation now equals 10 times your CE modifier. Stone constructs created by your other Innate Technique features gain an additional 10 hit points.

jjk5e.automationNotes: Stone cubes: 10 × CE mod HP; other stone constructs +10 HP (edit the summoned token).
